messages.swapped: Set down the {old}, picked up the {item}.
messages.nut_wrong: Not the neighbour. Go across, like drawing a star, so the wheel seats evenly.
messages.pattern_start: Tighten the nuts one at a time with 1-{count}. Go across, in a star.
messages.complete: Car's back on the ground and the spare is torqued down. You're good to go.

steps.label: Loosen the lug nuts
steps.success: Half a turn each. They're cracked loose while the tire still grips the floor.
steps.wrong_tool: Bare hands won't break these. You need the lug wrench.

fail.car_raised: The wheel just spins in the air. Crack the nuts loose while the tire's weight is still on the ground.

steps.label: Place the jack and raise the car
steps.success: Saddle on the pinch weld, a few pumps, and the flat's off the ground.
steps.wrong_tool: You'll want the floor jack from the tool cart for that.

fail.car_raised: It's already up on the jack.
fail.nuts: Up it goes... and now the wheel will spin when you try the nuts. Loosen them first, while it's still on the ground.

steps.label: Remove the nuts and the wheel
steps.success: Nuts off and in a safe pile, flat wheel off the hub.
steps.wrong_tool: Spin the loose nuts off with the lug wrench.

fail.car_raised: With the car's whole weight on that wheel it isn't going anywhere. Raise the car first.
fail.nuts: Those nuts are still torqued on. Loosen them before anything comes off.

steps.label: Fit the spare wheel
steps.success: Line up the holes and push it flush onto the hub.
steps.wrong_tool: You'll need the spare from the trunk for that.

fail.wheel: There's already a wheel on there. The flat one.
fail.car_raised: The hub's sitting at floor height. The spare won't slide on until the car is raised.

steps.label: Hand-tighten the nuts
steps.success: All five threaded on and snugged by hand, so the wheel sits straight.

wheel.flat: Those nuts are holding the flat on. Swap the wheel first.
wheel.*: There's no wheel on the hub to thread them onto. Fit the spare first.

nuts.tight: They're already on, and very tight.
nuts.loose: They're still on the old wheel.

fail.car_raised: With the car's weight on the wheel there's nothing to thread.

steps.label: Lower the car
steps.success: Valve open, slow and steady, the tire takes the weight again.

nuts.loose: The flat's still on. Swap the wheel before you lower the car.
nuts.removed: Lowering onto a wheel with no nuts? It would fold right off the hub. Thread them on first.
nuts.*: Not yet. The wheel isn't secured.

steps.label: Fully tighten the nuts in a star pattern
steps.success: Every nut done, across the star. That wheel is seated dead straight.
steps.wrong_tool: Hands won't get them tight enough. Use the lug wrench.

fail.car_raised: Cranking on a raised wheel just spins it. Lower the car so the tire holds it still.

nuts.*: Thread the nuts on by hand first.
